description: Current UK government service facts verified against gov.uk, by service: passport-renewal-adult, passport-child, driving-licence-renewal, provisional-licence, change-address, vehicle-tax-sorn, register-to-vote, register-birth, register-death, blue-badge, self-assessment, national-insurance-number, universal-credit, eu-settlement-scheme, evisa, eta. Each service carries its official gov.uk page, the online startUrl, the page's last update date, figures (fee, processing time as stated, eligibility and required documents — each with value, unit, the quoted sentence and its source URL), and a dated list of changes since 2025 (passport fees from 8 April 2026, the ETA fee and enforcement, the BRP → eVisa switch, the end of the Universal Credit 2-child limit, Making Tax Digital for Income Tax). Common names resolve as aliases (passport → passport-renewal-adult, brp → evisa, sorn → vehicle-tax-sorn). No service returns the listing with the aliases; an unknown service answers covered:false with the nearest keys.
